guidance.heading: Guidance
section: We benefited from strong oil and natural gas liquids prices in the first nine months of 2026, with diversified revenue exceeding our initial expectations. However, lower than expected production at Guadalupe-Palmarejo and Candelaria have resulted in fewer Precious Metals GEOs YTD 2026.

For Total GEO sales, we have narrowed our guidance range, toward the midpoint of our original guidance. Total GEOs, which included GEOs from our non-gold assets, are impacted by the relative performance of commodity prices to gold.
The following table presents our YTD 2026 actual performance compared to our 2026 guidance.

1 | Our 2026 guidance assumes the following commodity prices: $4,500/oz Au, $75.00/oz Ag, $2,000/oz Pt, $1,650/oz Pd, $100/tonne Fe 62% CFR China, $70/bbl WTI oil and $3.00/mcf Henry Hub natural gas. GEOs for the 2026 Revised Guidance are calculated based on fixed conversion ratios based on the prices assumed in this 2026 guidance.

2 | Our guidance does not reflect any incremental revenue from additional contributions we may make to the Royalty Acquisition Venture with Continental. Our initial guidance did not reflect any buy-backs which may be elected at the discretion of certain operators with the exception of the partial buy-back of the Cascabel royalty and stream which occurred in March 2026.
